scope: Expose typed Inspector value requirements and validation feedback to assistive technology.

verified_gap.issue: Typed Inspector controls displayed a live validation message but did not associate the message with the control or expose the registry value contract required state.
verified_gap.impact: Keyboard and screen-reader users could receive an error without a programmatic relationship to the affected value; required semantics were absent from the control.

implementation.change: Every typed value control now references its validation message with aria-describedby, exposes aria-required from the shared value contract, and toggles aria-invalid as validation fails and clears.
implementation.constraints: No native form submission behavior changed; optional asset-picker search/action controls are excluded.
implementation.dependencies: No dependency added; native WAI-ARIA attributes.

checks: required state follows the registry contract
validation message id is referenced by aria-describedby
invalid value exposes aria-invalid=true and visible guidance
valid correction clears aria-invalid and stale guidance

full_editor_browser_regression.includes: Inspector lifecycle and responsive type matrix, rich text, IME, media, structured content, editor shell accessibility and Save/Publish regression
